text:
Aisha (AE): Quick heads-up — Zenith (resale partner) asked to run a joint POC next week. Requirements: shared workspace for logs/telemetry, SSO/SAML, a security questionnaire (72 Qs), and a firm pricing for a Dedicated pool (they want predictable latency). Can we assemble the pre-sales artifacts?
Connor (Solution Eng): +1. I can own the infra/runbook. Need answers: expected concurrent sessions, avg seq length, model family (decoder/encoder), and whether we need KV cache persistence across sessions.
Priya (Partner PM): Zenith's infra lead said 50 concurrent sessions peak, 2k token average per session, mostly chat/assistant style. They're okay with a 3-month reserved commit if cost looks reasonable. They're available Wed/Thu for kickoff.
Luca (DevRel): Re: telemetry — we have out-of-the-box event hooks for request/response, token counts, and latency. Can push to Datadog or a Prometheus exporter. Example telemetry snippet for streaming SDK:```js
const stream = client.chat.stream({model: 'rw-compat-v1', onToken: token => dd.metric('tokens.count', 1)});
stream.prompt('summarize...');
```
Connor (Solution Eng): For architecture, propose: partner traffic -> Redwood API (ingress) -> routing policy to Dedicated pool (pinned model) -> telemetry exporter -> partner side SIEM. I'll draft a diagram. Also we should recommend quantized model variant to hit their latency SLO.
Sophie (InfoSec): I pulled the questionnaire. We can answer ~65/72 with standard controls. The 7 items needing follow-up are: HSM key custody, formal penetration test evidence, cross-tenant data isolation, and egress certs. Please attach any customer-specific compliance docs. I'll prepare CSV of questions with proposed answers.
Gina (Finance): Pricing note: rough estimate for Dedicated: base monthly fee for reserved 4x A100 equiv + per-token overage. For a 3-month commit our ballpark is $XXk/mo. I'll run a tighter calc once Connor confirms GPU sizing and expected token volume.
Aisha (AE): Action items: Connor = runbook + arch diagram by Monday EOD; Sophie = questionnaire CSV and highlight the 7 blockers; Gina = pricing calc after Connor's sizing; Priya = schedule Wed/Thu kickoff and share calendar invite.
Connor (Solution Eng): I'm going to spin a small staging config and test prefix caching. Quick paste of the config I'll use for the POC (will put in Confluence):
```yaml
pool:
  type: dedicated
  min_instances: 2
  max_instances: 8
  model: rw-compat-v1-8q
routing:
  policy: latency_first
telemetry:
  export: datadog
```
Connor (Solution Eng): I'll also add an autoscale policy to cap cost for non-peak hours and a fallback to a smaller quantized variant.
Priya (Partner PM): Partner asked about SSO timeline — they need SAML configured and a test user. Sophie / Eng-security, can you confirm we can have IdP metadata and test creds by the kickoff?
Sophie (InfoSec): Yes, we can support SAML. Need partner to provide IdP metadata and a test SP assertion endpoint. We'll run the metadata through our checklist.
Luca (DevRel): I'll prepare a short sample repo with the telemetry exporter and a notebook that shows token & latency dashboards. Should have it by Tuesday. Link will be posted here when ready.
deploy-bot: Canary deployment of the dedicated-poc branch to staging completed — logs: https://ci.redwood/1234 :white_check_mark:
Aisha (AE): Great progress, thanks everyone. Connor, flag any enterprise blockers ASAP so I can escalate to customer success. Priya — once you post the invite I'll ping the partner. :thumbsup:
Connor (Solution Eng): Will do. Expect runbook and sizing numbers by Monday 6pm PST.
Priya (Partner PM): Invite sent for Wed 10am PT — includes Zenith infra lead + SOC. Calendar link: https://cal.redwood/zenith-poc-kickoff
Aisha (AE): Closing note — prepping a one-pager (arch, telemetry, pricing high-level) for the partner pre-read. I'll upload to the thread shortly.
